Structural uses frozen candidate invalidation and entry price: reject invalidation on wrong side; stop distance=max(structural_distance,1.5ATR,6pips,0.2pip); round price outward to0.00001, reject >30pips, TP2R. Broker stop/freeze levels assumed0, not verified.

Three v1 nonnative hypotheses use trigger low-0.10ATR for long/high+0.10ATR for short as a declared structural proxy, not native candidate stop.
forex.management: Only at observed M5 opens, after old broker barriers and time exit; never consume present-bar high/low before modification. BE at observed profit>=1R, price offset0.5pip. Trailing at>=1.5R, distance=max(1.5closedATR,3pip), improve>=0.5pip. Round away from quote, enforce0.2pip quote/target gap; never loosen SL or change originalR, birth or TP. Native5second throttle irrelevant at5minute sampling; no claim of tick parity.
forex.sampling: One position per model/policy/hold/path; no new entry on a bar occupied at its open, same as v2. Also paired diagnostic labels for same entries resolved under all3structural policies; overlapping and not a portfolio.
forex.primary: hold60, stop_first, report all models/policies and fees, no best-cell promotion
forex.paired_primary: STRUCT_BE minus STRUCT_FIXED and STRUCT_BE_TRAIL minus STRUCT_FIXED on same resolved entry and originalSL, hold60, bothpaths. Report grossR deltas; fixed fee cancels.
forex.gap_and_exit: Same v2 unavailable handling, open gap stop at observed adverse price, TP capped; intrabar exits have containing-bar/upper-bound timestamps. Partial unknown outcomes excluded from means, not scored0.

binary.paired_horizon: Only entries with resolved labels at all3expiries; report payout82 stake-return differences10minus5 and15minus5, weekly bootstrap. No winner selection.
binary.costs: No Forex commission imposed on BO. Actual platform quotes, payout and manual fills unavailable.

statistics.report_cost_breakeven: Mean gross pip per resolved sample, assumption constant pip fee and unchanged decisions; not a verified broker cost or guarantee
statistics.multiple_tests: 1080FX summaries,135BO summaries plus contrasts/descriptive groups. Unadjusted95percent intervals; no confirmatory significance claims.
statistics.stability: Report every declared model and chronological period, no threshold or session chosen after outcomes.
